EXECUTIVE SUMMARY MEMO (privileged; contains Fee Letter terms, so restrict distribution per CL s.9 / FL s.3)
To: Jennifer Whitfield; Michael Torres. Re: Project Ridgeline, Everstone draft Credit Agreement (CA) dated June 9, 2025 vs Commitment Letter (CL, incl. Exhibit A "EA" and Fee Letter "FL", all May 22, 2025), standalone Term Sheet (TS) and Sung no-flex email (June 2, 2025). For the June 16, 2025 negotiation session.

BOTTOM LINE. The draft is not conforming. The table below logs 68 line items (14 Critical, 14 High, 14 Medium, 26 Low or conforming); nearly all favor lenders, a few favor Borrower (marked "B+"). None is authorized. Sung's email confirms Northbrook "will not exercise any of its market flex rights" and that the CA must reflect CL/EA "without modification or deviation." Several changes sit inside flex envelopes (TLB margin +25 bps within FL s.2(a)'s 50 bps; springing trigger 30% equals the FL s.2(e) floor), i.e., flex by drafting. FL s.2(i) also requires written notice to exercise; none is in the file. Severity follows the template key; the 25 bp margin increase is rated Critical because the key lists "unauthorized interest rate increase" and the cost (about $875,000/yr, about $6.1M over seven years undiscounted, before the 10 bp CSA) is material.

TOP ISSUES (raise first, no compromise):
1. Pricing: TLB margin 4.25% vs 4.00% (ABR 3.25% vs 3.00%); new 10 bp SOFR Adjustment; Revolver floor 0.50% vs 0.00%.
2. Closing conditions: CA s.4.01(h)-(l) and closing paragraph add KYC, insurance/broker, lien searches, three years of audited financials, no-injunction and Acquisition Agreement representations, plus Closing Date Mortgages and local-counsel opinions. CL s.6 says (a)-(g) are the sole conditions and expressly bars audited financials, insurance certificates, surveys and title as conditions. This breaches the SunGard-style framework.
3. s.6.11 cash-hoarding prepayment ($30M cap with sweep) is barred by EA s.16.
4. Missing RP leverage basket (4.50x) and incremental revolver; free-and-clear cut to $50M/50% from $75M/75%.
5. Springing covenant trigger 30% ($22.5M) vs 35% ($26.25M); equity cure period 10 vs 15 BD; no "no Event of Default" cure protection.
6. EBITDA: addback cap 20% vs 25%, 12 vs 18 months, new cap on restructuring, omitted non-recurring addback.
7. Soft call 12 vs 6 months; asset-sale reinvestment 360 vs 545 days; MFN 18 vs 12 months; permitted acquisition leverage 5.50x vs 5.75x.
8. Extra Events of Default (MAE, sanctions) not in EA s.18.

FLEX WAIVER. The email is useful waiver/estoppel evidence and goes to Northbrook's own counsel (Chiang), but it is unsigned by Borrower, CL s.12 requires amendments/waivers signed by all parties, and FL s.2 flex survives until syndication completes or Closing. Its boilerplate disclaims waivers "except as expressly stated herein"; the waiver is express. Recommend a countersigned flex-waiver letter before Closing. NY-law enforceability not independently researched.

RECOMMENDED NEXT STEPS: (1) send Chiang, copying Sung, a conformed-to-CL issues list before June 16; (2) require a CL-conforming redline and compliance certification; (3) seek signed flex waiver; (4) do not trade Critical items; trade B+ items and Low items only; (5) note ticking fee: FL s.1(e) 0.25% on $425M accrues from July 22, 2025 if Closing is July 31 (about $29,500 for ten days), so timetable matters; (6) correct template errors below.

DEVIATION REPORT. Severity: C/H/M/L. "+" = Borrower-favorable. Direction otherwise adverse to Borrower. Cites: CL/EA section, then CA section.

ECONOMIC
1 TLB margin. EA s.3 / CA 1.01 "Applicable Rate", 2.05(a). SOFR+4.00%, ABR+3.00% vs 4.25%/3.25%. C. Revert; no flex noticed.
2 SOFR Adjustment. TS XVIII mentions an unquantified "credit spread adjustment"; EA silent / CA 1.01: flat 10 bps on all SOFR loans, floor applied after (about $350k/yr on TLB). H. Delete or fix at zero.
3 TLB floor 0.50%: conforms. L.
4 Revolver floor. EA s.3 / CA 1.01 "Floor", 2.05(b). 0.00% vs 0.50% (FL s.2(d) says Revolver floor not flexible). H. Revert.
5 ABR floor. CA "ABR" adds 1.00% minimum not in EA. L. Delete.
6 OID/net proceeds 98.0, $343M: conforms (CA 2.01(a)). L.
7 Maturities. EA s.4 / CA 1.01: dates hard-coded July 31, 2032/2030 vs "7/5 years from Closing Date". M. Draft as years from actual Closing.
8 Amortization $875k quarterly conforms (CA 2.07). Mandatory prepayments applied in direct order only vs Borrower election of direct or inverse (EA s.7; CA 2.09(f)). M.
9 Soft call. EA s.6 / CA 2.08(a)(iii): 1% for 6 months vs 12 months; limited to Repricing Transactions (EA also reaches Borrower-directed mandatory prepayments), Agent yield determination "conclusive". H. 6 months.
10 Fees. Arrangement fee 1.75% ($6,125,000), $150k agent fee, ticking fee sit in FL; CA 2.06(b)-(c) cross-refers; sources/uses tie at $780M. L.
10A Revolver size $75M, LC $15M, swingline $10M, 0.375% commitment fee, 0.125% fronting, 2% default rate: conform (CA 2.01(b), 2.03, 2.04, 2.06, 2.05(c)). L.
11 Incremental revolving commitments omitted (EA s.15(c)); CA 2.15 term loans only. C. Add.
12 Free-and-clear. EA s.15(a) / CA 1.01, 2.15(a)(i): $75M/75% vs $50M/50% (about $25M less capacity). C. Revert.
13 Ratio incremental 3.59x/3.85x conforms; but no reclassification, no limited-condition/payment-and-bankruptcy-only default test for free-and-clear, no separate-facility form. M.
14 MFN. EA s.15(d) / CA 2.15(d): 18 months vs 12; no free-and-clear carve-out after 12 months; 50 bps and 10 bps floor conform. H.

MANDATORY PREPAYMENTS
15 ECF thresholds. EA s.7(a) / CA 2.09(b): 4.00x/3.50x vs 3.75x/3.25x. L (B+); also adds $2.5M ECF de minimis and lender decline mechanics (B+). Do not volunteer.
16 Annual voluntary-prepayment credit. EA s.7 / CA 2.09(b): credit only against ECF and only if internally funded. M. Credit against all mandatory prepayments.
17 Asset sales. 100% and $7.5M de minimis conform; reinvestment 270+90=360 days vs 365+180=545 (CA 2.09(c)). H. Revert. 75% cash conforms; non-cash basket 10% of Total Assets vs EBITDA (B+, L). Template's "$15M annual threshold" does not exist in CL/TS.
18 Debt issuance 100%: conforms. L.
19 Extraordinary Receipts. EA s.7(d) / CA 2.09(d)-(e): $2.5M vs $5M threshold; separate insurance rule, 270+90 reinvestment vs 365+180, $2.5M/$5M casualty thresholds. H. Revert.
20 Anti-cash-hoarding. EA s.16 prohibits; CA 6.11 caps Unrestricted Cash at $30M with quarterly sweep. C. Delete.

FINANCIAL COVENANT
21 Ratio 6.25x conforms. L.
22 Trigger. EA s.9 / CA 7.01(a), 11.02(a)(iii), Exh. A: 30% ($22.5M) vs 35% ($26.25M). C (equals FL s.2(e) floor; flex waived).
23 Term lender protection. TS IX: TLB has no maintenance covenant; CA lets Required Lenders (incl. term lenders) accelerate on breach. H. Add revolver-only standstill.
24 Equity cure frequency (2/4, 5 life) conforms. L.
25 Cure period. 15 BD vs 10 BD (CA 7.01(c)). M.
26 Cure effect. EA s.9(e) no Event of Default if timely cured; CA lacks deemed-cure language and 8.01(c)(i) has no grace; also bars cure amounts in later test periods. H.
27 Cure amount cap (no over-cure): conforms. L. TS uses net-debt reduction vs EA EBITDA increase; CA follows EA (EA governs per TS).

NEGATIVE COVENANTS
28 RP general basket and tax/management exceptions conform; sponsor fee cap $2M (EA "to be agreed"). L.
29 RP leverage basket (TNL 4.50x unlimited) omitted; CA 6.04(f) is circular. C. Insert.
30 RP builder basket conforms. L. Employee repurchases fixed $5M with $10M cap vs greater of $5M/5% EBITDA. M.
31 Debt baskets (general, 4.25x, 5.50x, leases, acquisition debt): conform (CA 6.01). L.
32 Investments general $20M/17.5%: conforms (6.05(f)). L.
33 Permitted Acquisitions. EA s.12(b) / CA 6.06(c): 5.50x vs 5.75x. H. Also adds 60-day guarantor joinder, related-business and certificate conditions. M.
34 Asset-sale covenant. EA s.13 permits other sales up to $2.5M individually/$7.5M per year; CA 6.09 omits. M.

DEFINITIONS / EBITDA
35 Cost-savings cap. EA s.14 / CA 1.01 "Consolidated EBITDA"(g): 20% vs 25%. H (about $8M less on $97.5M base).
36 Realization period 12 vs 18 months; adds certification. H.
37 Other addbacks. CA caps restructuring (f) at greater of $10M/10%; omits non-recurring/extraordinary addback and acquisition/disposition run-rate; (i) needs Agent approval vs "customary". H. Transaction-cost addback broader (B+).
38 Immaterial Subsidiary. EA s.8: $5M/$15M vs $2.5M/$10M (CA 1.01, 5.10, Sch. 1.01). M.
39 Change of Control. EA s.18 "to be defined"; CA adds 50.1% test and Second Lien/Material Indebtedness cross-trigger. M.
40 Closing Date leverage 3.59x/3.85x: conform. L.

SECURITY
41 Collateral. EA s.8 vs CA Excluded Assets/Sec. Agt Exh. E: no Excluded Accounts or $500k commercial-tort carve-outs; adds Mortgages on fee property over $2.5M (CA 4.01(a), 11.13; TS "material real property"; not in EA). M/H. Conform.
42 Equity pledges (100% domestic; 65%/100% foreign): conform (5.10). L.
43 Guarantor carve-outs: no adverse-tax exclusion except by Agent consent. L.

CONDITIONS PRECEDENT
44 SunGard framework. CL s.6 / CA 4.01: conditions limited to (a)-(g) vs added (h)-(l). C.
45 KYC (h). C. 46 Insurance/broker (i). C. 47 Lien searches (j). C. 48 Audited financials (k) (CL expressly bars). C. 49 No injunction (l). C (arguably covered by Acquisition closing). 
50 Acquisition Agreement representations condition (closing paragraph). C.
51 Executed documents: Closing Date Mortgages, local-counsel opinions (4.01(a), (d)(ii)). C.
52 Company MAE: conforms except "as in effect on date hereof (May 15)" vs May 22. L.
53 Specified Representations. EA s.21 / CA 1.01: ICA rep omitted (and absent from Art. V); AML/OFAC cross-references point to 5.16 not 5.21; Use of Proceeds added (TS only); conflicts rep narrowed (B+); materiality standard conforms. M.
54 Certificates. Solvency by CFO of Target (CL) vs Borrower or Target (4.01(d)(i), Exh. F). L.
55 Equity $330M conforms; Schedule 2.01 shows Northbrook as sole lender (syndication pending) (4.01(e)); fees (f) and acquisition (g) conform substantially; waiver standard "Agent and Lenders" vs Northbrook. L.

REPS / EoD / MISC
56 Reps scope customary; non-specified reps only for revolver draws (4.02): conforms. L.
57 Added EoDs: MAE (8.01(l)), sanctions (8.01(k)). H.
58 Rep default lacks 30-day cure (8.01(b)); receiver event lacks 60 days. M.
59 Cross-default, judgment, ERISA $25M, 5 BD interest grace: conform. L.
60 Required Lenders >50%: conforms. L.
61 Sacred rights omit lien subordination (10.01(b)). M.
62 Assignments: minimums, $3,500 fee, Borrower consent/deemed 10 BD conform; Agent consent for TLB assignments follows TS, not EA (revolver only). L.
63 Governing law NY conforms; jurisdiction non-exclusive vs exclusive; no GOL 5-1401 reference. L.
64 Benchmark replacement: ARRC-style conforms. L.
65 Expenses/indemnity. CL s.8 one-counsel limit absent in CA 10.05(b). M.
66 Reporting 120/60 days conforms to EA (TS says 90/45; EA controls); key-man notice 11.03(d) added. L.

DRAFTING RED FLAGS
67 CA recites "Stock Purchase Agreement" with Fund VI as party vs CL "Agreement and Plan of Merger" (Borrower, Target, holders); drives Company MAE and CP(g). M.
68 CA lists Northbrook as Collateral Agent too; CL names Continental Trust only. Undefined terms (Material Restricted Subsidiary, Subordinated Indebtedness, Transaction Documents). L.

DOCUMENT NOTES. TS claims it is "substantively identical" to EA; it is not (ECF framing, Specified Reps adding use of proceeds/perfection, solvency officer, 90/45-day reporting, Agent assignment consent, equity-cure mechanics, guarantor wording). TS and EA both say CL controls; FL governs fees/flex. Template Deal Summary cites wrong EA sections and invents the $15M asset-sale threshold; fix before circulating. Unverified: no external law researched.
